x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a new hire record is received from the HR system, When the onboarding lifecycle event starts, Then activity sets trigger in the agreed sequence relative to start date Given the hiring manager has pending onboarding to-dos, When they open Employee Center, Then the to-dos are listed with due dates
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: Onboarding is orchestrated as a lifecycle event with tasks for HR, IT, facilities and the manager
